messages:
Maya K.: Quick check-in 004AC10: we need owners for SparkPlug refapp OSS launch + associated benchmark webinar. Who volunteers for blog, bench narrative, webinar ops, and lead routing?
Sam L.: I can do webinar ops + confirmations. Proposing Thu May 7 10am PT. Ill create the registration page and HubSpot flow.
Jordan P.: Ill own the benchmark narrative + reproducibility notes. Plan: three mini-scenarios (short-chat, semantic-search, bulk embeddings) + concise cost/latency table.
Nikita R.: Ill draft the OSS launch post and social snippets. Want the headline and key numbers from Jordan by Wed.
Ash V.: Routing/tracking here. Will set up HubSpot lists (sparkplug_registered, sparkplug_cloners) and a webhook to tag contacts. Need the reg form fields and UTM scheme.
Maya K.: Suggested UTMs: utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=sparkplug_launch. Add utm_content=bench_card for card clicks.
Jordan P.: Draft headline for Nikita: "SparkPlug: a compact refapp that slashes inference unit cost while keeping production latencies low." Will give a one-liner + 3 metrics by Wed 9am.
Sam L.: Legal flagged embargo if benchmark details are included. Jordan, can you put repro steps in a private repo branch until sign-off?
Jordan P.: Yep. I'll open a docs PR with run commands, seeds, and docker tag; mark it "private-draft". Link once created.
Nikita R.: Social plan: 1) short thread announcing repo; 2) benchmark card (single-image); 3) 30s demo clip for LinkedIn. Draft tweet below: 
```
SparkPlug refapp is live 680 10Quickstart in 5 mins to prototype inference for your app. Join our webinar May 7 to see how we measure cost & latency. Register: https://go.redwood.ai/sparkplug?utm_campaign=sparkplug_launch&utm_content=bench_card
```
Maya K.: Nice. Include a "Try it in Cloud" and "Clone repo" CTA. Also add an assets folder with a 5-frame gif for quickstart.
Ash V.: On routing: form fields we want: name, email, company, role, primary use case. Slack alert to #leads with those fields + link to HubSpot record. Also tagging: "sparkplug_refapp" on contact.
DevRel-bot: Reminder set 0: "SparkPlug webinar page" due 2026-05-01.
Sam L.: Ill take care of email templates: reg confirmation, 1-day reminder, 1hr reminder, and post-webinar recording send.
Nikita R.: Blog outline idea: 1) Why SparkPlug (dev problem) 2) How it works (quick arch) 3) Benchmarks (summary table + caveats) 4) Quickstart + gif 5) CTA + community links.
Jordan P.: Bench table for the blog (summary only): 
``
Scenario | Median latency | Cost / 1M tokens
chat-demo | ~115ms | ~$11
semantic-search | ~170ms | ~$22
bulk-embeds | ~260ms | ~$7
```
Maya K.: Good. Put the full numbers, raw logs, and run script in the repo appendix. Legal: Jordan will redact infra names and make the reproducibility checklist clear.
Ash V.: I'll add UTM params to all outgoing links and create HubSpot smart lists for scoring. Also creating a low-friction "Clone & Try" automation that emails a quickstart if someone clones the repo.
Sam L.: Dry run: propose Wed May 4 11am PT for a 20-min rehearsal. Can Jordan and Nikita join?
Jordan P.: Available. Will bring slide with methodology and reproducibility checklist.
Nikita R.: Available. I'll rehearse narrative + demo handoff.
Maya K.: Owners & deadlines: Jordan: bench PR & metrics (due Wed 09:00). Nikita: blog draft + assets (due Thu EOD). Sam: reg page + emails + dry run (due Fri). Ash: HubSpot & routing + UTMs (due Fri).
DevRel-bot: Task created: "SparkPlug launch checklist" assigned to @Maya K., due 2026-05-01.
Ash V.: Small ask: can we capture attendee intent in the form (PoC, evaluation, interested in Dedicated)? adds helpful routing.
Sam L.: Good idea. Add a multi-select: PoC, Prototype, Production, Other.
Jordan P.: Note for the bench narrative: include a short section on quantization/instance types used and a note about potential variance on very long seq lengths.
Nikita R.: Putting draft in drive: https://docs.google.com/sparkplug-launch-draft (comments open).
Maya K.: Thanks team. Please update this thread with blockers. If legal flags embargo, call it out here immediately so we can reschedule if needed. :thumbsup:
